title: I Left the Baby-Shower Registry With the Gift They Already Returned

parts.text: I checked the registry at 4:11 p.m. after the shower thank-you listed a blender I had bought, now marked purchased by someone else because they had returned mine for store credit. I was thirty, cousin, holding a screenshot from the week I ordered it. I forwarded the order, the thank-you, and the new purchased flag to the cousin-host, not the group chat. She called embarrassed and said they needed a different color. I asked for the blender back or the credit. She sent the credit. I bought myself a kettle I actually wanted. Showers are not laundering. Thank-yous should match boxes. I still like the baby. I like kettles that stay. The registry has one honest line again, and it is not my name.
